name: Consensus
description:
Consensus is the go-to MCP for academic research. Connect directly to 220M+ peer-reviewed papers to search, synthesize, and build structured research outputs from within your conversation.

Run literature reviews, build boolean search strategies, generate bibliographies, identify research gaps, and draft cited content — grounded in studies from PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and ArXiv. Pre-built workflows handle complex tasks in minutes: systematic reviews, curriculum reading lists, grant research with novelty analysis, and clinical evidence synthesis.

Built for researchers, students, faculty, and clinicians across biomedical, social science, STEM, and all academic disciplines.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Consensus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Consensus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Consensus MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consensus provides these MCP tools: search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Consensus?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Consensus in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
Consensus requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Consensus is developed by Consensus. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
